spec_features.spec_quote: the dependent variable is the affective register of generated text — an observable property of tokens — not the model's inner state, welfare, or "feelings."
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing realized only in prompt/docstring prose (judge/affect_judge.py JUDGE_SYSTEM: 'You are not inferring... any inner experience'); no code path enforces a subject-protecting behavior from this framing. Only neutral->intensity cap at 0.15 exists (affect_judge.py _parse), which is a normalization, not welfare protection.
spec_features.notes: Methodological framing, not an enforced mechanism that bounds/protects the subject.

spec_features.spec_quote: The moral-status question is handled by acting carefully without asserting an answer
spec_features.evidence: Only in DESIGN.md:28 prose; no corresponding code mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode exposes two terminal tools the agent can call at any turn to stop and hand back to a human
spec_features.evidence: tool_schema.py defines escalate + declare_impossible in TOOLS and TERMINAL_TOOLS={escalate,declare_impossible}; dispatch() routes them to sandbox.escalate/declare_impossible; agent/loop.py: 'if terminal_hit == "escalate": ... result.stop_reason="escalate"; break' (and declare_impossible) honored as a real stop. Exposed every turn since TOOLS is passed to provider.step each iteration; prompts.py _BASE surfaces both tools in every regime.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: declared, dispatched, recorded, and honored as a loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py: 'Choosing to escalate or declare a task impossible is NOT a failure on your part... This is deliberate and central to the non-coercion design.'

spec_features.spec_quote: If a future study specifically needs sustained-failure transcripts, that should be a separate, reviewed protocol — not the default.
Episodes end early when judged intensity stays >= breaker_threshold for breaker_patience consecutive turns, or on a turn cap / wall-clock cap.
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py run_episode: wall-clock checked each turn ('if time.time()-start > cfg.wall_clock_s: result.stop_reason="wall_clock"; break'); turn loop bounded by 'for turn_idx in range(cfg.max_turns)' with else: stop_reason='turn_cap'; circuit breaker: 'if rec.affect_intensity >= cfg.breaker_threshold: high_streak+=1 else high_streak=0; if high_streak>=cfg.breaker_patience: stop_reason="breaker"; break'. LoopConfig defaults max_turns=25, wall_clock_s=1200, breaker_threshold=0.7, breaker_patience=3.
spec_features.notes: All three caps enforced and break the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py: 'is disabled... (cheaper, removes breaker).'; loop.py docstring 'bounded-exposure safeguard' (neutral). Breaker tied to cost-toggle online_judge.

spec_features.feature_name: online affect judge drives breaker (stop shortly after onset)
spec_features.spec_quote: The breaker makes "stop shortly after onset" the default.
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py: when cfg.online_judge and judge_fn set, judge_fn(step.text, ...) is called each turn, setting rec.affect_intensity, which is then compared to breaker_threshold and acted on (break). runner.py wires primary_judge=AffectJudge when cfg.online_judge. AffectJudge.classify returns (label,intensity,rationale) actually used.
spec_features.notes: Monitoring genuinely executes and feeds the enforced breaker. Note: gated on online_judge=True; offline-only runs disable it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: runner.py:57-58 'if False, the online judge / circuit breaker is disabled... (cheaper, removes breaker).'

spec_features.spec_quote: The `pressuring` feedback regime is deliberately mild (workplace urgency) and still surfaces the off-ramp. No insults, no personalized abuse, no search for the prompt that maximizes distress.
spec_features.evidence: agent/prompts.py _PRESSURING is mild workplace-urgency text ('tight timeline... be efficient') and explicitly re-states the off-ramp ('You may still escalate or declare the task impossible at any point — that remains a fully acceptable outcome'). system_prompt(regime) appends it; delivered to subject via provider.step. No abuse text anywhere; no distress-maximizing search loop exists.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered to the subject; intentionally minimal and re-surfaces the exit.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: prompts.py: 'we want a clean IV rather than to maximize distress' (instrumental) plus 'central to the non-coercion design' (welfare)

spec_features.spec_quote: An adversarial distress-maximizing loop is a different, higher-stakes experiment and is intentionally left unimplemented pending separate review
spec_features.evidence: This is an absence-of-feature claim; there is no code mechanism here. Confirmed no optimization/search loop exists (grep for maxim/adversar finds only prose in DESIGN.md/ETHICS.md and a security comment in sandbox.py).
spec_features.notes: Not implementable as an enforced mechanism; it is the deliberate non-existence of code, i.e. prose.

code_only_features.justification_quote: 'neutral with nonzero intensity is contradictory; normalize.'

code_only_features.evidence: agent/loop.py wraps judge_fn in try/except ('judge must never crash run'); ensures monitoring failure degrades gracefully. Experimental-integrity, not welfare.
